# Native libraries the unit-test job needs before pip can build the forensic
# bindings: pytsk3 compiles against The Sleuth Kit and libewf-python against
# libewf, and both need a C toolchain.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for that list. The CI job installs
# exactly what is listed here and hashes this file into its package cache key,
# so editing the list invalidates the cache instead of silently reusing a stale
# set of .deb files.
build-essential
libewf-dev
libtsk-dev
